title: Canonical degree-zero theta on augmented sections of any module
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $y\in Y$, $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Use the formal fibre $i_n:X_n\to X$, stalk $M=(R^0f_*\mathcal F)_y$, cohomology $C_n=H^0(X_n,i_n^*\mathcal F)$ over $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ and predicate IsFormalFunctionsTheta of [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. Tensor pullback and its fixed adjunction unit $\eta_n:\mathcal F\to i_{n*}i_n^*\mathcal F$ are those of [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $\alpha:(f_*\mathcal F)_y\to M$ for the stalk map of the canonical zeroth right-derived augmentation [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and $\gamma_n:\Gamma(X_n,i_n^*\mathcal F)\to C_n$ for the canonical global-sections augmentation [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For every $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-linear $\theta:M\to C_n$ satisfying IsFormalFunctionsTheta, every open $V\subseteq Y$ containing $y$ with $X_n=i_n^{-1}(f^{-1}V)$, and every section $t\in\mathcal F(f^{-1}V)$, one has $\theta(\alpha(\operatorname{germ}_V(t)))=\gamma_n(\operatorname{res}^{i_n^{-1}(f^{-1}V)}_{X_n}(\eta_{n,f^{-1}V}(t)))$. The restriction is along the displayed containment, and the augmentations and unit are fixed, not chosen isomorphisms. No properness, flatness or coherence assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Construct termwise restricted injective resolutions using module_open_restriction_injectives and the explicit restrictAppIso section comparisons. Transpose the tensor unit under the restriction adjunction to construct compatible open choices, without flatness.

Apply resolutionSectionClass_zero_augmentation to the section corresponding to t; cancel restrictAppIso and the equality transports. Germ naturality identifies its germ with the stalk of the canonical direct-image augmentation applied to germ(t).

Apply IsFormalFunctionsTheta to this augmented section. tensorUnit_open_degree_zero identifies its image with the restriction of the desired augmented tensor-unit section. The restriction is injective: W=top, its section map is an isomorphism, and moduleCohomologyFMap_basic_degree_zero conjugates the cohomology map by section comparison isomorphisms. Cancel it.

theorem formalFunctions_degreeZero_augmented_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (θ : formalFunctionsStalk f y F 0 →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
      formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y F 0 n)
    (hθ : IsFormalFunctionsTheta f y F 0 n θ)
    (V : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ V)
    (hV : (⊤ : (formalFibre f y n).Opens) ≤
      (formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (t : F.presheaf.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))) :
    θ (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).map
      ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).toRightDerivedZero.app F)).hom
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf
          V y hy t)) =
    ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (formalFibre f y n).toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F)).hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE hV).op
          ((((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
            (formalFibreι f y n))).unit.app F).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).hom t))
